SharedFlowBundle.name: ISAM-Common-SetSamlHeaders
SharedFlowBundle.Description:
Reusable building block: sets the final X-SAML-Assertion / X-SAML-Assertion-Compressed / X-SAML-Subject-Id request headers and mirrors subject/lifetime into isam.exchanged.* variables. Used by every SAML-bearing type after ISAM-Common-CompressAssertion; NOT by ISAM-JWT-Token (type 6), which sets its own X-Access-Token header directly since there's no SAML assertion involved.
INPUT variables (already set by ISAM-Common-ValidateSignature / ISAM-Common-CompressAssertion by the time a caller reaches this flow): saml.assertion.output, saml.assertion.compressed, saml.subject.id, saml.assertion.notBefore, saml.assertion.notOnOrAfter
